svg.text: pick the two schedules to compare (or click in A)
the question = y-axis of A and B
x = latency d (0–6 steps) · y = the question · one panel per horizon h
── sync - - - naive ····· inpaint │ = 95 % interval ○ = current R and C
click a point → it becomes C · shift-click → R · hover → value and Δ vs R
one row = one start state · one column = one schedule (52)
■ success □ failure · bands: where R and C disagree first
③ drag over rows → select start states → A recomputes on them only
④ click a row → C and D replay that start state under R and C
the table seen from above, R and C side by side, same moment
R · Sync: standing still, waiting for its next plan
C · Inpaint: moving · picture k steps old
dotted = what the policy saw · moved N px since
grey T = block · dashed T = goal · ● pusher (the robot's tool) · ━ moves done · ┄ rest of the current plan
⋯ block and pusher as seen in the camera picture the plan came from · ━ jump at a chunk switch
← → step · hover a planned point → when planned
the same episode over time, left → right
think = computing a plan · act = executing it (hatched = standing still) · stick = jump size
current chunk: ○ camera picture → think → act
click = move the time cursor (C follows) · hover a chunk → its plan in C · window → that path in C
